WHERE toLower(coalesce(dd.evidenceStatus, '')) =~ '(source[-_ ]?)?verified' AND toLower(coalesce(r.resolutionScope, '')) =~ '.*(whole|entire|full|tdoc|document).*' AND NOT toLower(coalesce(r.resolutionScope, '')) =~ '.*(part|proposal|section|clause|subset).*'
MATCH (r)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting)
MATCH (o)-[:HAS_CR|BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK]-(cp:CRPack)
RETURN DISTINCT clause AS clause, o.tdocNumber AS document, dd.dispositionCode AS disposition, m.meetingNumber AS wg_meeting, cp.crPackId AS cr_pack
